title: The Old Tombstone (The Record of Virtue)
summary: An ancient marble tombstone in the overgrown churchyard bore only the worn fragments of an epitaph: "He walked with God and loved his brother."...
full_text:
An ancient marble tombstone in the overgrown churchyard bore only the worn fragments of an epitaph: "He walked with God and loved his brother."

Generations of townsfolk had forgotten his name, but the schools he had founded still taught the young, and the shaded trees he had planted along the road still refreshed the weary.

True honor lives in the enduring blessings left behind, not in the granite that marks our dust.
moral: The stone may crumble, but the record of an unselfish life is engraved in the book of life.
